selection: Whole v0.4.6 design-system WallpaperTransformPolicy.kt (WallpaperTransform, sanitizeWallpaperTransform, crop geometry, visible source region, applyWallpaperGesture), app WallpaperPlaybackCoordinator.kt (decorative-motion lease arbiter and its composition local), HomeWallpaperSelection.kt (URI plus both device transforms as one selection) and HomeWallpaperPresentation.kt (LocalHomeWallpaperSelection), with the original WallpaperTransformPolicyTest and WallpaperPlaybackCoordinatorTest. The original HomeWallpaperAdjustmentSheet.kt (232 lines) is carried as the signature oracle for the Windows-owned sheet and is not emitted.
purpose: Emit the four pure wallpaper foundation files and the two original suites verbatim from the home refresh wrapper producer (main files into its main output, suites into its original test root). All six declare only new names: no vendored copy exists, so no exclude. The Android HomeWallpaperAdjustmentSheet needs the v0.4.6 HomeWallpaperBackdrop, WallpaperMedia load states, the request based WallpaperPaletteStore and WallpaperDeviceTabRow, none of which the Windows tree has, so a desktop-owned sheet with the same public signature binds it to a mouse drag and wheel crop editor.
